posts.hook: Amelie Lens and Sara Landry played a b2b set in London over the weekend 💪
posts.caption:
Amelie Lens and Sara Landry played a b2b set in London over the weekend 💪

Taking place at new Greenwich Peninsula venue Magazine Open—Air on Friday (21st August), the show marked the duo’s first time playing together in the UK. The two-hour set kicked off at 8PM, but was briefly interrupted by a technical issue.

After taking over from SPFDJ, Lens and Landry’s opening track was interrupted by crackling from the sound system before the audio cut out completely. Landry then addressed the crowd, saying: “We’re having a technical issue, we’re gonna get it fixed and then we’ll be back with you.”
